_doc: Recovery recipe(s) the agent can choose from. CURRENTLY FIXED to a single recipe ('adapter+head+proprio' with MLP adapter, bn=1024) because this is the empirically-best recipe across all prior experiments, and the framework's closed-loop driver hardcodes --freeze_sidecars False during training. The other recipes (direct / adapter_only / adapter_mlp_0.5M) are intentionally removed from the agent's choice set: prior pilots showed they consistently under-recover at the mask sizes we care about. Agent must emit recovery='adapter+head+proprio' in its JSON output.

recipes.description: FIXED recovery: MLP adapter (bn=1024) + action_head + proprio_projector all trainable. Empirically the best recipe (used to reach 96.5% at k=28). Cost ~2-4h on 3-GPU for 10k steps.
